description: This file contains data structures, constants, and functions related to message export jobs in Mattermost, including job state management, channel metadata, user activity, and backend configuration.

classes.name: JobData
classes.description: Represents the current state of a message export job, including metadata, cursor, posts, and timing information.

classes.name: JobDataExported
classes.description: Contains exported fields of JobData for serialization.

classes.name: BackendParams
classes.description: Holds configuration and store references for backend operations.

classes.name: ExportParams
classes.description: Parameters used for exporting messages, including metadata, posts, and configuration.

classes.name: WriteExportResult
classes.description: Results of writing an export, including warnings and transfer times.

classes.name: RunExportResults
classes.description: Summary of the results after running an export, including counts of posts, files, and channels.

classes.name: ChannelMemberJoin
classes.description: Represents a user joining a channel.

classes.name: ChannelMemberLeave
classes.description: Represents a user leaving a channel.

classes.name: MetadataChannel
classes.description: Metadata information about a channel for export purposes.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: Aggregated metadata for message export, including channels and counts.

methods.name: JobDataToStringMap
methods.description: Converts JobData to a map of string key-value pairs.

methods.name: StringMapToJobDataWithZeroValues
methods.description: Creates JobData from a map of string key-value pairs, with default zero values.

methods.name: UpdateCounts
methods.description: Updates message and attachment counts in Metadata for a specific channel.

methods.name: GetInitialExportPeriodData
methods.description: Calculates and caches channel memberships, metadata, and total posts expected for export.

methods.name: CalculateChannelExports
methods.description: Returns metadata and user activity histories for channels with activity during a period.

methods.name: ChannelHasActivity
methods.description: Checks if a channel had user activity between start and end times.

methods.name: GetJoinsAndLeavesForChannel
methods.description: Determines user join and leave events for a channel within a time period.

methods.name: GetPostAttachments
methods.description: Retrieves file attachments for a post.

methods.name: ChannelTypeDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a channel type.

methods.name: GetBatchPath
methods.description: Generates a file path for a batch zip file based on parameters.

methods.name: GetExportBackend
methods.description: Returns the file backend for exporting data based on configuration.

methods.name: GetFileAttachmentBackend
methods.description: Returns the file backend for message attachments based on configuration.

methods.name: IsDeletedMsg
methods.description: Determines if a message post is marked as deleted.
